Authenticity 0.3.1.

- **Em dashes become `--`.** When you replace characters (one at a time, or with *Replace unusual characters…*), an em dash now becomes `--` where it stands and the spaces around it stay as they were: "a — b" becomes "a -- b", "a—b" becomes "a--b". Before, it was turned into a comma. The horizontal bar and the other em-dash forms do the same. An en dash still becomes `-`, now also when it has spaces around it.
- **A shorter description** for the community plugin list.

Nothing else changed. The helper program and the other native programs are unchanged: keep using the ones from the [native release 0.3.0](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/authenticity/releases/tag/native-0.3.0).

The plugin's files are `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, built by GitHub Actions from this tag and attested: `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/authenticity`.
